chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight
spiritual_reading:
#
 The Eight
 States
 of Divine
 Love

**
¶1.
** Divine
 love in
 its living activity is
 present in eight distinct
 spiritual states.

**¶2
.** The first state
 in
 which it dw
ells is the found
ational ground
 of wisdom
 —
 the deep
est recept
ive plane
 of the mind,
 established
 beneath all
 other
 states and
 utt
erly prior
 to the
 whole
. It
 is the ground
 and
 basis of the
 entire
 natural
 mind, and the in
most perception that underlies every
 other faculty
.

**¶3.**
 The second state in
 which it dwells is the Divine
 Itself, the origin of all truth
;
 for
 the Divine
 Itself is established
 in its own
 infinite
,
 omn
ipotent perception
.
 Thus
 divine
 love is
 first
 in the Divine
 Itself. All
 derivative
 powers
 that
 proceeded
 from the Divine were
 made
 manifest through it, and love
 itself came forth
 with them and
 was revealed by means
 of them.

**¶4
.** The third state in which it
 dwells is the celestial archetype
 of the regenerate will —
 the pr
imal human
 form cloth
ed in protective truths as
 in
 armor
. Divine
 love res
ides upon
 the external form of the fully regenerated
 human.


**¶5.** The
 fourth state is that divine
 love which
 has
 been refined
 and
 separated from all the
 fac
ulties of wisdom.
 It dwells at
 the outermost boundary of doctrine,
 within the vessel of understanding that carries truth
 in states
 of full
 illumination.

**¶6
.** The fifth state is that divine
 love which
 res
ides within
 the faculty of perception that gives
 light
 amid
 states
 of spiritual
 obsc
urity, immersed within
 natural
 truth.

**¶7.
** The sixth state is that divine love
 which has been dist
illed from the whole
 of
 spiritual
 experience
. The divine
 operating power clothed it upon its
 own
 external form as a gar
ment of truths, over the calling
-
forth and the responsive reception. By
 means
 of it, that
 power
 ordered
 many states into
 being
. Then
 it descended into
 lower conditions
 and divested itself of those covering
 truths before the guardian of the threshold
 between the
 interior
 and the exterior mind
.

**¶8.**
 The seventh state is the
 living divine
 love
 that belongs
 to the regener
ated natural mind,
 and
 it
 is itself
 the in
most perception
 there
. For
 it
 is the first
 principle
 laid
 down in the new ground
 of
 the mind
;
 upon
 it all
 things
 are rebuilt
. It
 is the first course
 of
 the foundation
, and
 it
 is a
 governing
 crown over
 the entire natural
 plane
.
 It
 lies
 beneath
 all
 higher
 states, yet
 extends
 its
 domin
ion over the whole realm of falsity
.

**¶9.**
 The eighth state is that divine love which
 shall
 be made
 manifest within
 the individual person
, and its
 coming
 sign
ifies holy
 awe and spiritual combat. It displays
 and
 dis
closes its sign through
 the upheaval of confrontation with
 evil. It shall
 be revealed through
 the twin
 vessels of good and truth —
 the illumin
ated will
 and the illumin
ated understanding together
.

**¶10.**
 This
 is the manner
 in which living
 divine love exists across
 these
 eight spiritual
 states.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [holy] living f[ire] is present i[n] eight places.

The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it and is ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and basis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.

The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o clothed himself in his] armour. Again, it is this fire [that dwells] on the body of the Perfect Man.
[The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
[The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [and dwells] within the water.

[The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.

[The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [world, in each] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [is mighty, and] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].

The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [ ... ... ] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [ ... ] in it, in the [ ... ] whole [ ... ]
